mentions.name: Pilgrim
mentions.description: This iOS app supports walking sessions built around the practice of walk, talk, meditate; an Android port is currently in progress.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on app for walking based on the practice of walk, talk, meditate.

For now it's just for iOS but currently I'm working on porting to Android.

https://pilgrimapp.org/
